rationale: DUB-focused knockout library (~93 DUBs, 10 guides each, 10 non-targeting) in HeLa cells carrying a HIF-ODD-GFP (HRE) reporter (Pauzaite et al. 2024, EMBO J). Activator screen: cells in 1% oxygen sorted for GFP-low at day 8, compared with the unsorted library at the same time (S7 vs L7). Suppressor screen: cells in 21% oxygen sorted for GFP-high (S8 vs L8). The four per-sample GEO files are merged by guide in prepare.R. The column letters follow the authors' own MAGeCK configuration on Zenodo (exp1: test S8, control L8; exp2: test S7, control L7), so S is sorted and L unsorted; GEO attaches the files to the opposite GSMs (GSM8004837 'FACS' holds L8), which is a labelling swap. One library per population, so run_barcs.R uses the no-replicate path and the calls are screening-level. Only 10 non-targeting guides: calibration and the control null are weak.
